blind.description: A stylized potted spiral topiary consisting of a square off-white stone planter box with four rounded corner feet, filled with reddish-brown soil, from which a short wooden trunk supports a sculpted spiral cone of green foliage topped with a small sphere. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures, resting properly on its feet without an added base slab.
blind.from_above: A concentric textured green spiral/circle tapering to a small central ball, casting a distinct conical stepped shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 2.8 feet tall (just under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1 foot wide.
